# Project Atlas — Design Revisions

> **SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — FICTIONAL DATA.**

## REV-A — 2025-03-14 — Initial chassis

- Configuration: four-wheel skid-steer, independently driven wheels.
- Motor: 12 V DC gear motor, 60 rpm, 4 units.
- Motor controller: revision A board.
- Enclosure ingress rating: IP54.
- Estimated mass: 5.2 kg.

## REV-B — 2025-04-20 — Battery change

- Battery: lithium pack, 5000 mAh, 14.4 V nominal, 6 cells in series.
- Enclosure ingress rating: unchanged at IP54.
- Estimated mass after change: 5.8 kg.

## REV-C — 2025-05-22 — Motor controller and battery upgrade

- Battery: lithium pack, 5200 mAh, 14.4 V nominal.
- Motor controller: revision B board added, one per wheel.
- Enclosure ingress rating: still IP54. No retest was performed after the change.
- Estimated mass after change: not recorded.
